title.zh: 美国OCC正式批准Ripple National Trust Bank，将支持RLUSD及企业数字资产托管业务
title.en: 美国OCC正式批准Ripple National Trust Bank，将支持RLUSD及企业数字资产托管业务

current_state.zh: The U.S. OCC formally approved Ripple National Trust Bank, letting Ripple support its RLUSD stablecoin and offer enterprise digital asset custody through a federally regulated banking platform, according to CEO Brad Garlinghouse.
current_state.en: The U.S. OCC formally approved Ripple National Trust Bank, letting Ripple support its RLUSD stablecoin and offer enterprise digital asset custody through a federally regulated banking platform, according to CEO Brad Garlinghouse.
